newsitem.title: USA: RTZ's Kennecott, USW continue Utah talks.
newsitem.headline: RTZ's Kennecott, USW continue Utah talks.

text.p: The United Steelworkers and Kennecott Utah Copper Corp on Thursday continued their talks through the day, a union spokesmen said.
But the union's secretary Carolyn Jensen could not characterize the tone of the talks, or disclose if any progress had been made. She also did not know how late into the evening the talks might go.
Some 1,800 union workers went on strike on Wednesday, leaving Kennecott to operate with 400 non-union staffers, a company spokeswoman said.

But Alexis Fernandez declined to disclose the level of production the company was able to achieve. She also declined comment on whether or not the company was continuing to hedge on the futures market. The company is seeking a six-year contract. A three year accord expired on September 30. Kennecott is a unit of RTZ Corp Plc.
